notes.title: The sequel to "Dog Licking Simulator" is coming!
notes.notes:
First of all, I would like to thank all the bosses for their love of "Dog Licking Simulator", and now the sequel "Mine Boss Simulator" of "Dog Licking Simulator" has finally appeared.
"Mine Boss Simulator" was born out of the gameplay of currency speculation in "Lick Dog Simulator", and at the same time refined it, adding new gameplay such as futures trading, funds, and rankings.
At the same time, the game plot inherits the branch of "Wang Xiaomei coming out of the closet", telling a series of stories such as the fourth child's development abroad.
Favorite bosses can join the wishlist, and the game will be released at the end of August!
